summary: Qualify checkpoint covering-index initialization and first-open cost

replay.detail: Document the installed-schema prerequisite, extend the reopen control to missing-index refusal, installed read-only and immutable scratch-copy consumers, and add an explicitly ignored index-build characterization at 615,894 and 1,000,000 synthetic eligible rows. The bundled SQLite measurement covers index DDL and COMMIT time and live-page footprint; it excludes population, full Store startup and managed writer return. The covering query and index are unchanged.
